examples.arabic: ضحك احمد وقال نعم هو صديق رائع لكن خالة زوجتي لا تحبه كثيرا في الحديقة
examples.english: Ahmed laughed and said: "Yes, he is a wonderful friend, but my wife's maternal aunt doesn't like him much in the garden."
examples.transliteration: Ḍaḥika Ahmad wa qaala: Na'am huwa ṣadīq rā'i' lakin khālatu zawjatī lā tuḥibbuhu kathīran fil-ḥadīqah.
examples.storyTitle: The Neighbor and the Strange Friend

examples.arabic: ردت الخالة بسعادة وقالت مساء النور كيف حالك يا سارة
examples.english: The aunt replied happily and said "Good evening (response), how are you, Sara?"
examples.transliteration: Raddat al-khalah bi-sa'adah wa qalat masa' an-nur kayfa haluki ya Sara.
